claim_rule: Only true capabilities may be described as established. Live local NEXUS means native verification through a pinned local QSOL-NEXUS runtime, not network federation. The FED-side ORACLE evidence membrane is implemented, but live ORACLE transport and Holodeck-to-ORACLE synthetic admission remain false until separately reviewed donor-side support exists. ARK preservation is an offline FED-side content-addressed preservation contract and does not claim archival authority.

promotion_requirements.oracle_live_transport: requires a follow-up QSOLKCB/QSOL-ORACLE PR implementing and gating the native ORACLE transport/export side
promotion_requirements.oracle_holodeck_synthetic_admission: requires a separate reviewed synthetic non-evidence input contract after ORACLE live transport exists
promotion_requirements.production_networking: requires later production deployment hardening and evidence
promotion_requirements.remote_execution: not admitted by the current constitutional posture
promotion_requirements.interoperable_federation: requires Phase 6 independent multi-implementation interoperability evidence
